notes: One Work team owns implementations; original project IDs are historical authorship, not extra workers.
Every unresolved claimed batch, including submission, review, integration, requested repair or blocker, occupies a team slot.
Two active batches are the default; a third requires a durable concrete independence exception and actual active work.
Repairs and completion have priority. Do not claim backups speculatively or build on unaccepted dependencies.
The reviewer must actually be a non-author of the complete package, including original implementation; role labels or a new ID do not establish independence.
After substantive independent exact-head approval, integrate automatically under the sole lock, with exact-head CI/audit and green resulting main CI/audit.
Existing v2 state is read-only except the authorized one-time handoff and infrastructure locking during deployment.
